mapper.insert: insert into user_follow (follower_id, followee_id, created_at) values (#{follow.followerId}, #{follow.followeeId}, #{follow.createdAt})
mapper.select: select count(*) from user_follow f inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = f.followee_id and u.del_flag = 0 where f.follower_id = #{followerId}
